name: force-timelapse
title: Force Timelapse
author: bespoked
description: Forces timelapse frame capture on every print, regardless of the Snapmaker app's timelapse setting. Your slicer must call TIMELAPSE_START, TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME, and TIMELAPSE_STOP (most do when timelapse is enabled in the slicer). Pairs well with the Timelapse plugin for the Fluidd/Mainsail menu. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Capture a timelapse on every print, no app toggle needed.
attributions:
# Attributions - force-timelapse

**Plugin author:** paxx12 (Extended Firmware overlay `36-feature-print-preferences`), packaged by Bespok3d

Forces timelapse frames on every print.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extended Firmware overlay `36-feature-print-preferences` | paxx12 | GPL-3.0 | no | yes |

The Klipper config in this package is the `timelapse_force.cfg` tweak from the Extended Firmware overlay
`36-feature-print-preferences` (paxx12), GPL-3.0. It ships here with the same macro, the
same `rename_existing` name and the same body; only the file name and the layout differ.
